claim: In SIR, s + i + r stays 1 at every step up to rounding, and the conservation check proves it symbolically.
derivation: ds/dt = −β·s·i, di/dt = β·s·i − γ·i, dr/dt = γ·i, as fractions of one population: β = 0.4 and γ = 0.2 per day, i₀ = 0.001, so s₀ = 1 − i₀ and r₀ = 0, and s + i + r = 1 at the start (E5).

Symbolically (C3, P1): the invariant s + i + r is the sum of the compartments with coefficients 1, and every rate is a polynomial, so d(s + i + r)/dt = (−β·s·i) + (β·s·i − γ·i) + (γ·i), whose like terms cancel exactly: the check reports it proved symbolically.

Numerically, RK4 conserves it too: every stage k of E3 is a value of f, and f_s + f_i + f_r = 0 at every point, so k_s + k_i + k_r = 0 for each stage and a step changes s + i + r by (Δt/6)·(0 + 2·0 + 2·0 + 0) = 0 in exact arithmetic (E3).

Only rounding moves it: a step rounds each of s, i and r, values at most 1, within 1.1e-16 each, and the stages' cancellation within a few roundings of rates at most β + γ = 0.6, times Δt/6. That is under 5e-16 a step, so under 2.5e-12 over 5000 steps (500 days), even with every rounding in the same direction.
Tolerance: the family's own, 10⁻⁹ of the starting size 1 (C3), 400 times that worst case.
